title: People Power Revolution
description:
From February 22-25, 1986, the **People Power Revolution** (also known as EDSA Revolution) peacefully overthrew Philippine dictator Ferdinand Marcos.

Millions of Filipinos gathered on Epifanio de los Santos Avenue (EDSA) in Manila, forming a human barrier against military forces.

The non-violent revolution inspired similar movements worldwide and restored democracy to the Philippines after 21 years of authoritarian rule.
